fields.Group: stitch QSPI_IO1 hop, ADC_SCKI via A
stitch QSPI_IO1, IO2, NCS hops, flash end

texts.text: A. Compute core: U1 and its decoupling, HSE, reset, BOOT0, user LED
B. Power entry: USB-C, ESD, 5 V mux, 3V3 buck, 3V3A LDO, VBUS sense, power LED
C. Settings store: QSPI NOR for the EEPROM emulation
D. Audio out: PCM5102A, output filter, TPA6132A2 headphone amp (Section=hp_out, parent may DNP)
One ground, GND. SGND is the headphone amp sense line; the consumer bonds it to GND at the output jack sleeve with a net tie.
SWD on Tag-Connect pads J3 (03 row 4)
Supply flags: nets fed through passives or from the connector
F. Audio in (addendum 2026-09-24, fit-or-not): PCM1808 into SAI1 block B, slave on BCLK/LRCLK
Unpopulated: DNP the parts with Section=audio_in. Parent leaves LINE_INL/INR open
U8 AGND and DGND both on GND
Clock source series R at U1
G. Reference-transition stitching, 10 nF 3V3-GND, one per via group:
C56 U1-east I2S escapes; C57 U6-west I2S rises; C58 ADC_DOUT rise;
C59 QSPI_IO1 hop, ADC_SCKI via A; C60 QSPI_IO1, IO2, NCS hops, flash end; C61 ADC_SCKI via B
H. ADC supply (rev 3, Codex audit 2, GO 2026-09-27): 5V, U10 TPS63070 5.98 V forced PWM (PS/SYNC low), EN via R36,
C64 on VAUX; U11 LP5912-5.0 blocks reverse current; R33 sink; R20 to ADC_VCC. Pin driver U12 TLV9062 inverting
